newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan king meets UAE president in Rabat.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan king meets UAE president in Rabat.

text.p: King Hassan of Morocco and United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Soltan al-Nahayan met in Rabat on Wednesday, the official MAP news agency said.
The two leaders met at Sheikh Zaid's residence in Rabat. Morocco's Crown Prince Sidi Mohammed was also present at the meeting, MAP said but gave no details.
Sheikh Zaid arrived on Morocco on Friday on a private visit after undergoing a medical checkup in the United States.
